sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat('
SELECT * FROM dbo.FactBookings 
WHERE booking_date > ''',string(activity('Lookup-Lastload').output.firstRow.lastload),''' 
AND booking_date <= ''',string(activity('Lookup-Latestload').output.firstRow.latestload),'''
')

SELECT MAX(booking_date) AS latestload
FROM dbo.FactBookings
